profile_text.body:
The AI Now Institute is a nonprofit founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York, NY. On its website, it describes itself as an organization that challenges and reimagines the current trajectory for AI. Its staff includes Chief AI Scientist Heidy Khlaaf, Aya Ibrahim, and Sarah Myers West. The institute argues that high-risk industries such as aviation and banking are subject to independent oversight and meaningful penalties, and that AI companies should be no exception. Khlaaf says the low reliability and accuracy rates of AI in critical environments with life-or-death consequences concern her more than threats of the technology wiping out humanity, which she calls fear-mongering.

The institute does not list any products. Its public position is critical of unregulated AI development. Aya Ibrahim says policymakers have a track record of being deferential when dealing with the tech sector, describing a culture of learned helplessness among the same policymakers who oversee energy and commerce committees and the FDA. Sarah Myers West says nobody is helped by an unregulated sector engaged in a race to the bottom.

No litigation cases are associated with the institute. New York state records list 458 law exposure entries for the AI Now Institute. No MCP servers are associated with it.
